title: PaLM-style z-loss lambda=1e-4
mechanism: L = L_ce + 1e-4 * (log Sum exp logit)^2; grad += 2*lambda*z*softmax

title: WSD: warmup-stable-decay (tail 20% linear)
mechanism: lr = base_lr in stable phase warmup..0.8*post; linear decay base_lr->min_lr in last 20%

title: Disable weight decay on token embeddings
mechanism: AdamW apply_wd flipped false on w_tok in CPU + GPU optimizer wiring

title: Fixup-style zero-init of MHA + FFN output projections
mechanism: w_o and w_proj initialized to zero (via new_scaled with scale=0) instead of GPT-3 1/sqrt(2N) residual scaling

title: Focal cross-entropy (gamma=2)
mechanism: L = (1-p_t)^2 * (-log p_t); grad = standard_CE_grad * s where s = -dL/dp_t * p_t

title: Zero-init position embeddings
mechanism: w_pos = zeros instead of uniform[-0.02*sqrt(3), 0.02*sqrt(3)]; position bias learned from zero, causal mask provides order info

title: Composite: fixup + pos-embed zero-init
mechanism: w_o = w_proj = 0 (fixup) AND w_pos = 0 (pos-embed zero) simultaneously
reason: transformer_smoke::cpu_transformer_converges_on_copy_task failed - 22% relative loss drop in 200 steps, test threshold requires 30%. Math correct, warm-up too slow for smoke window.

title: He/Kaiming-uniform init for LinearProj
mechanism: LinearProj::new and new_scaled bound = sqrt(6/d_in) instead of sqrt(6/(d_in+d_out))
reason: transformer_primitives::mha_causal_backward_matches_numerical failed - rel err 0.083 vs TOL 0.050. Sharper softmax at d_model=8 exceeds central-difference precision. Math correct, test tolerance too tight for this init regime.

title: Logit temperature T=2 before softmax in CE
mechanism: L = -log softmax(2*logit)[target]; grad = 2*(softmax(2*logit) - 1_target). Effective 2x LR through LM head pathway.

title: Composite: fixup zero-init + WSD schedule
mechanism: w_o = w_proj = 0 (fixup) AND cosine_warmup body replaced with WSD (warmup -> stable base_lr -> linear decay tail 20%)

title: AdamW eps default 1e-8 to 1e-6
mechanism: AdamWConfig default eps changed; floors denominator in update step. Effect mainly on parameters with very small squared-grad EMA.

title: LayerNorm eps 1e-5 to 1e-3
mechanism: All LayerNorm eps changed from 1e-5 to 1e-3 (CPU + 8 GPU dispatch sites). Looser variance floor in normalization denominator.

title: Composite: fixup + WSD + pos-embed at 1/4 magnitude
mechanism: w_o = w_proj = 0 (fixup) AND w_pos at 1/4 baseline magnitude (uniform[+-0.0087]); WSD schedule was intended but file write was blocked.
reason: transformer_smoke::cpu_transformer_converges_on_copy_task failed - 28% relative drop vs 30% threshold. Combination of fixup + quarter-pos still slowed warmup below smoke barrier.

title: Attention scale x 2/3 (softer)
mechanism: scaled_dot_product attention scale = (2/3)/sqrt(d_k) instead of 1/sqrt(d_k), in CPU + 4 GPU dispatch sites.

title: Per-block apply_wd: deep half only
mechanism: In CPU model.rs and GPU build_grad_ops, set apply_wd=true only for blocks with li >= n_layer/2; shallow blocks weight matrices skip WD

title: Position embedding init at 0.5x baseline magnitude
mechanism: w_pos init uniform[-0.5*scale, +0.5*scale] where scale = 0.02*sqrt(3). Half the baseline magnitude.

title: Composite: fixup + WSD + pos-embed at 1/2 magnitude
mechanism: w_o = w_proj = 0 (fixup) AND w_pos init at 0.5x baseline magnitude AND WSD schedule (warmup -> stable -> linear tail 20% decay)
reason: transformer_smoke::cpu_transformer_argmax_sanity failed - model predicted 0 instead of 2 on identity copy task. Different failure mode than quarter-pos (iter 13); smoke gate non-monotonic in pos magnitude.

title: Token embedding init at 0.5x baseline magnitude
mechanism: w_tok init uniform[-0.5*scale, +0.5*scale] where scale = 0.02*sqrt(3). Tied LM head sees half-magnitude initial logits.

title: Composite: fixup + WSD + w_tok at 1/2 magnitude
mechanism: w_o = w_proj = 0 (fixup) AND w_tok init at 0.5x baseline magnitude AND WSD schedule. Tied LM head sees half-magnitude initial logits.
notes: ANTI-STACKING: wins vs baseline but +0.234 BPB regression vs combo-fixup-wsd parent (-0.308). Tok-half destroys the parents primary learning channel when sublayers are zeroed.

title: Composite: w_tok and w_pos both at 0.5x init magnitude
mechanism: Both w_tok and w_pos init uniform[-0.5*scale, +0.5*scale]; embed_forward halved.
notes: Slightly super-additive vs pos-half+tok-half standalones (predicted -0.044, actual -0.053). Distinct mechanisms.

title: Composite: WSD schedule + both w_tok and w_pos at 1/2 magnitude
mechanism: WSD schedule (warmup -> stable -> tail 20% linear decay) AND w_tok and w_pos both at 0.5x baseline magnitude
notes: Mildly sub-additive: predicted -0.102, observed -0.094 (+0.008 overlap). First sub-additive composite — WSD and embed-half share weak overlap in mechanism.

title: Zero-init w_o (MHA output) only
mechanism: w_o = LinearProj::new_scaled(d, d, 0.0, rng) only; w_proj keeps GPT-3 residual scaling. MHA sublayer = 0 at init; FFN sublayer non-zero.
notes: NEW BANK-BEST SINGLE-CHANGE. Outperforms full fixup (-0.251) by +0.08; FFN zero-init in iter 4 was actually mildly harmful.

title: Composite: fixup-mha-only (w_o = 0) + WSD schedule
mechanism: Zero-init w_o (MHA output) only; FFN w_proj keeps baseline GPT-3 scaling. WSD schedule (warmup-stable-decay over tail 20%).
notes: NEW BANK-BEST. Mildly sub-additive (predicted -0.381, observed -0.376). +0.067 over prior best combo-fixup-wsd.

title: Zero-init w_proj (FFN output) only
mechanism: w_proj = LinearProj::new_scaled(d_ff, d_model, 0.0, rng); w_o keeps GPT-3 scaling. FFN sublayer = 0 at init, MHA non-zero.
notes: Confirms iter 22 interpretation: FFN-side zero-init is harmful by +0.025 standalone. fixup-mha-only is the better single-tensor change vs fixup-full.

title: Composite: fixup-mha-only (w_o=0) + both embed halves
mechanism: Zero-init w_o; w_tok and w_pos both at 0.5x baseline magnitude. FFN w_proj keeps baseline.
notes: ANTI-STACKING: technical win vs baseline but +0.239 regression vs fixup-mha-only parent (-0.332). Confirms init-residual-zero x embedding-magnitude-halve consistently destroys ~0.24 of init gain. Same as iter 19. Composability rule formed.

title: Zero-init w_o in shallow blocks (0..n/2) only
mechanism: Post-process blocks in DecoderTransformer::new: zero mha.w_o.w for layer indices < n_layer/2; deeper blocks keep baseline.
reason: transformer_smoke::cpu_transformer_converges_on_copy_task failed at 13% relative drop in 200 steps (threshold 30%). Asymmetric init converges slower than either uniform zero (iter 22 passed) or baseline.

title: Additive gradient noise on d_logits (scale 0.005)
mechanism: cross_entropy_with_grad body: after standard d_logits, add per-element noise sampled from deterministic LCG seeded by (target XOR logits[0]). Scale 0.005 = 0.5% of target signal magnitude.
notes: Noise absorbed by AdamW m2; no effect at 1-epoch undertrained byte-LM scale.
